description.narrative: This project on integrating Public-Private Sector Dialogue (PPD) for Trade and Investment in Kenya, complements TMEA's Outcome 1 and 2 interventions and results relating to; •Reduction in transport cost and time and Increased efficiency in private sector logistics services provision.•Enhanced Customs, Port and other trade-related agencies efficiency.•Reduction in tariffs, taxes and levies (including sub-national) and increased tax incentives.•Enhanced efficiency of the Bureau of Standards, and improve private sector compliance. •Catalysing increase in exports, job creation (direct and indirect) and additional investment in targeted sectors in Kenya.The programme will have one Lead coalition Partner, the Kenya Private Sector Alliance (KEPSA) a national private sector apex body working jointly with the Kenya Association of Manufacturers (KAM) and other PSOs, sector-based associations and Civil Society organisations. The Lead coalition Partner is the Key convenor of PPD forums, EABC’s focal point and a link to the regional programme.
